<?php
class ReviewGeneratorChainChild11 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
function reviewGeneratorChainLeaf11() { $row = [new ReviewGeneratorChainChild11()]; try { echo "L|"; yield $row; yield $row; echo "N|"; $row[0] = null; } finally { echo "C|"; } }
function reviewGeneratorChainMiddle11() { try { echo "H|"; yield from reviewGeneratorChainLeaf11(); echo "I|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewGeneratorChainOuter11() { try { echo "G|"; yield from reviewGeneratorChainMiddle11(); } finally { echo "O|"; } }
function reviewGeneratorChainTarget11($first, $second) { echo "D|", $first[0] instanceof ReviewGeneratorChainChild11 && $second[0] instanceof ReviewGeneratorChainChild11 ? "HELD|" : "BAD|"; $first[0] = null; echo "X|"; $second[0] = null; echo "M|"; }
reviewGeneratorChainTarget11(...reviewGeneratorChainOuter11());
echo "E";
purpose: Two active Generator links expose the real leaf cache; two by-value row snapshots survive the leaf write and split between callee parameters without duplicated outer caches.

<?php
class ReviewGeneratorRetainedFirst11 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewGeneratorRetainedCurrent11 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
function reviewGeneratorRetainedChild11() { try { echo "L|"; yield "first" => new ReviewGeneratorRetainedFirst11(); echo "N|"; yield 0 => new ReviewGeneratorRetainedCurrent11(); echo "BAD|"; } finally { echo "C|"; } }
function reviewGeneratorRetainedOuter11() { global $child; try { echo "G|"; yield from $child; echo "BAD|"; } finally { echo "O|"; } }
function reviewGeneratorRetainedTarget11($first, $second = 0) { echo "BAD|"; }
$child = reviewGeneratorRetainedChild11();
try { reviewGeneratorRetainedTarget11(...reviewGeneratorRetainedOuter11()); } catch (Error $caught) { echo "T|", $caught->getLine(), "|", $caught->getTrace() === [] ? "NOFRAME|" : "FRAME|"; }
echo "M|"; unset($child); echo "E";
purpose: A temporary outer closes on key-order failure while an independent child CV retains the real current cache; child finally/cache cleanup waits for explicit unset.

class ReviewGeneratorReferenceChild11 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
function &reviewGeneratorReferenceLeaf11() { $value = new ReviewGeneratorReferenceChild11(); try { echo "L|"; yield $value; echo "N|"; $value = null; } finally { echo "C|"; } }
function reviewGeneratorReferenceOuter11() { try { echo "G|"; yield from reviewGeneratorReferenceLeaf11(); } finally { echo "O|"; } }
function reviewGeneratorReferenceTarget11($first) { echo "D|", $first instanceof ReviewGeneratorReferenceChild11 ? "HELD|" : "BAD|"; $first = null; echo "M|"; }
reviewGeneratorReferenceTarget11(...reviewGeneratorReferenceOuter11());
echo "E";
purpose: A by-reference leaf reached through a shared Generator link is dereferenced at SEND, before leaf-cell mutation, while the outer owns no duplicated current payload.
